description: Use when you need the list of pages a site publishes (to crawl it, find recent posts, or audit SEO): give a site URL (the sitemap is discovered from robots.txt Sitemap: lines, then /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap.xml) or a sitemap URL directly. Returns the page URLs with lastmod, changefreq and priority; for a sitemap index, returns its child sitemaps and (expand=true, default) the URLs of the first child sitemaps up to the limit. Gzipped sitemaps supported. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

expand.description: For a sitemap index, also read the first child sitemaps (true/false).

url.description: Site URL (e.g. https://example.com) or a sitemap .xml/.xml.gz URL.

name: sitemap
